title: AI 101
description: Configure, test, improve, and govern an AI support agent for a real nonprofit client.
objective: Deliver a grounded support agent with privacy protection and human escalation.
prompt: Build a support agent that solves the client need within its operational constraints.

title: XR Foundations
description: Design and test an accessible virtual career expo for 120 learners.
objective: Deliver a navigable expo that meets accessibility, capacity, and performance targets.
prompt: Build an XR expo solution and prove it survives realistic visitor and headset events.

title: Robotics
description: Sequence sense, plan, and act commands to guide a rover across the mission floor.
objective: Build the rover control loop in the correct order.
prompt: Select the three rover phases in order.

title: Automations
description: Build and test a governed registration-to-report workflow for a 120-seat event.
objective: Prevent duplicates and overbooking while delivering messages, attendance, rewards, and reports.
prompt: Configure the event workflow, run operational failures, improve it, and pass approval.

title: World Builder
description: Place 3D primitives and prototype a learning world directly in the browser.
objective: Place at least three structures on the mission grid.
prompt: Click the glowing floor to place three structures, then certify the world.
